# construct test and inferred transform; save program
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u043/system/state/workspace/programs/task-61309e85.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(v for r in g for v in r), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in g))
    # The corner bars indicate two vertical tracks; the isolated marker selects one.
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg and not (i==0 or i==h-1)]
    if not pts: return g
    r,c=pts[0]; mark=g[r][c]
    # extend the marker track and its reflected/translated partner from the corner bars
    top=[j for j,v in enumerate(g[0]) if v!=bg]
    bot=[j for j,v in enumerate(g[-1]) if v!=bg]
    delta=(sum(bot)//len(bot)-sum(top)//len(top)) if top and bot else 0
    for i in range(h):
        g[i][c]=mark
        q=c+delta
        if 0<=q<w: g[i][q]=mark
    g[r][c]=4
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
